title: How the U.S.-China Trade War Hurts the Rest of the World

sentences.en: Hi, I'm Andrew Ross-Sorkin.
sentences.zh: 嗨，我是安德鲁·罗斯-索金。

sentences.en: I cover business and policy for DealBook, a daily newsletter at The New York Times.
sentences.zh: 我负责《纽约时报》每日简报栏目 DealBook 的商业与政策报道。

sentences.en: On November 18th, I'm going to be interviewing some of the most consequential leaders in business, politics, and culture, including J.D.
sentences.zh: 11月18日，我将在纽约市 DealBook 峰会的现场采访商界、政界和文化界最具影响力的几位领袖，其中包括 J.D.

sentences.en: Vance, Elon Musk, Christine Lagarde, Zoran Mondani, and many others, live on stage at the DealBook Summit in New York City.
sentences.zh: 万斯、埃隆·马斯克、克里斯蒂娜·拉加德、佐兰·蒙达尼以及许多其他人。

sentences.en: You can watch some of these unguarded, unfiltered conversations as they happen.
sentences.zh: 您可以实时观看其中一些毫无防备、未经过滤的对话。

sentences.en: We're going to be live-streaming select interviews for anyone to watch, free, at nytimes.com on November 18th.
sentences.zh: 我们将于11月18日在 nytimes.com 上现场直播部分精选采访，供任何人免费观看。

sentences.en: If you're not already a subscriber, you can download the New York Times app to watch and get a month of free access to all of our journalism.
sentences.zh: 如果您还不是订阅者，可以下载《纽约时报》应用程序进行观看，并获得一个月的免费访问权限，畅读我们所有的新闻报道。

sentences.en: I hope you'll tune in.
sentences.zh: 我希望您能收看。

sentences.en: You won't want to miss it.
sentences.zh: 您一定不想错过。

sentences.en: From the New York Times, I'm Michael Barbaro.
sentences.zh: 我是来自《纽约时报》的迈克尔·巴巴罗。

sentences.en: This is Daily.
sentences.zh: 这是《每日新闻》。

sentences.en: Today.
sentences.zh: 今天是。

sentences.en: At the G7 summit in France, President Trump seemed determined to prove that he can wage a trade war with China without hurting the economy.
sentences.zh: 在法国举行的七国集团峰会上，特朗普总统似乎决心证明，他在对中国发动贸易战的同时不会伤害美国经济。

sentences.en: Peter Goodman on why that is proving to be an impossibility.
sentences.zh: 彼得·古德曼将为我们解析为什么这被证明是不可能的。

sentences.en: It's Tuesday, August 27th.
sentences.zh: 今天是8月27日，星期二。

sentences.en: Peter, why has all the focus of the G7 been on the U.S.
sentences.zh: 彼得，为什么 G7 的所有焦点都集中在美国

sentences.en: and China trade war, despite the fact that China isn't even in the G7?
sentences.zh: 和中国的贸易战上，尽管中国甚至都不是 G7 的成员？

sentences.en: Well, the seven countries in the G7, France, the United States, Italy, Canada, Germany, Japan, and the United Kingdom,
sentences.zh: 嗯，G7 的七个国家，即法国、美国、意大利、加拿大、德国、日本和英国，

sentences.en: first of all, you know, these are the seven major developed economies.
sentences.zh: 首先，你知道，这七个是主要的经济发达国家。

sentences.en: They view themselves as the sort of stewards for the global economy.
sentences.zh: 他们视自己为全球经济的某种管理者。

sentences.en: So they see their responsibilities as going beyond their own national interests.
sentences.zh: 因此，他们认为自己的责任超越了本国利益。

sentences.en: I mean, one can debate whether that's true or not, but that's certainly how they present it.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，人们可以争论这是否属实，但这确实是他们展现自己的方式。

sentences.en: But as a simple matter of arithmetic, the U.S.
sentences.zh: 但从简单的算术来看，美国

sentences.en: and China comprise roughly 40 percent of the global economy.
sentences.zh: 和中国约占全球经济的百分之四十。

sentences.en: If you tally up the value of goods and services that are produced and sold in the world every year,
sentences.zh: 如果你把每年世界上生产和销售的商品与服务的价值加总起来，

sentences.en: 40 percent of them come out of the U.S.
sentences.zh: 其中百分之四十

sentences.en: and China.
sentences.zh: 来自美国和中国。

sentences.en: So if there's any interference in their economies that causes them to buy less from other countries or to sell less to other countries,
sentences.zh: 因此，如果他们的经济受到任何干扰，导致他们从其他国家购买较少或向其他国家销售较少，

sentences.en: that will have the effect of disrupting business for pretty much everyone.
sentences.zh: 那将产生几乎扰乱所有人业务的影响。

sentences.en: So, you know, take Germany, for example.
sentences.zh: 所以，你知道，以德国为例。

sentences.en: I mean, this is the largest economy in Europe.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，这是欧洲最大的经济体。

sentences.en: There are deepening concerns about Germany's exports, Germany's factory orders.
sentences.zh: 人们对德国的出口和工厂订单越来越感到担忧。

sentences.en: And this influences the economic situation throughout Europe.
sentences.zh: 这影响了整个欧洲的经济形势。

sentences.en: A lot of the reason why Germany is now probably headed into recession is because of the trade war and the diminishing appetite from China for products that are made in Germany and end up feeding Chinese factories.
sentences.zh: 德国现在可能走向衰退的很大一部分原因，是由于贸易战以及中国对德国制造并在中国工厂进行加工的产品的胃口减弱。

sentences.en: Take Italy.
sentences.zh: 以意大利为例。

sentences.en: I mean, Italy is chronically growing weakly.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，意大利的经济增长长期以来一直疲软。

sentences.en: Some of that's demographics.
sentences.zh: 其中一部分原因是人口结构。

sentences.en: Some of it's wacky policies.
sentences.zh: 一部分原因是古怪的政策。

sentences.en: But some of it is that Italy is a pretty big exporter.
sentences.zh: 但部分原因在于意大利是一个相当大的出口国。

sentences.en: And there are worries now about whether any company will be able to sell its products to the world.
sentences.zh: 现在人们担心的是，任何公司是否还能将其产品销往世界各地。

sentences.en: Japan is a major exporter.
sentences.zh: 日本是一个主要的出口国。

sentences.en: Britain, a member of the G7, is now deeply immersed in year four of its torturous Brexit negotiations.
sentences.zh: 英国作为 G7 成员，目前正深深陷入其痛苦的脱欧谈判的第四年。

sentences.en: There's the real prospect they could leave without a deal governing future relations.
sentences.zh: 确实存在一种可能，即他们在没有达成规范未来关系的协议的情况下离开。

sentences.en: And the European Union buys almost half of Britain's exports.
sentences.zh: 而欧盟购买了英国近一半的出口产品。

sentences.en: So the thought of a trade war between the two largest economies on Earth, the United States and China, it's not going to make anybody in any of these countries richer.
sentences.zh: 因此，地球上最大的两个经济体——美国和中国之间爆发贸易战的想法，不会让这些国家中的任何一个人变得更富有。

sentences.en: Peter, play out one of these examples for us in a bit more detail.
sentences.zh: 彼得，请为我们更详细地剖析其中一个例子。

sentences.en: How exactly does the trade war between the United States and China potentially send a country like Germany into recession?
sentences.zh: 美国和中国之间的贸易战到底是如何可能让德国这样的国家陷入经济衰退的？

sentences.en: How does that work?
sentences.zh: 这到底是怎么运作的？

sentences.en: Well, Germany is a major exporter.
sentences.zh: 嗯，德国是一个主要的出口国。

sentences.en: So German industry is busy making everything from cars to medical equipment to steel and putting this stuff on ships that leave Germany and head out around the globe.
sentences.zh: 因此，德国工业正忙于制造从汽车、医疗设备到钢铁的各种产品，并将这些东西装上离开德国驶向全球的船只。

sentences.en: One of the major places a lot of those manufactured goods end up is China.
sentences.zh: 这些制成品大量流向的主要地方之一就是中国。

sentences.en: Now, China is facing tariffs into its largest export market, the United States.
sentences.zh: 现在，中国正在其最大的出口市场——美国面临关税。

sentences.en: No longer its largest export market, but traditionally its largest market.
sentences.zh: 虽然不再是其最大的出口市场，但传统上一直是其最大市场。

sentences.en: And that means that China is growing slower than it was before the trade war.
sentences.zh: 这意味着中国的经济增长速度比贸易战前要慢。

sentences.en: So if you're running a Chinese factory and you're looking at the likelihood that you're going to have a hard time exporting to the United States,
sentences.zh: 所以，如果你经营一家中国工厂，并且看到自己将很难向美国出口的可能性，

sentences.en: you now have less appetite yourself for the sorts of things you were buying from Germany.
sentences.zh: 你现在对自己从德国购买的各种物品的胃口也变小了。

sentences.en: You might be less likely now to place an order for German equipment that ends up in your factory.
sentences.zh: 你现在可能不太可能下订单购买最终进入你工厂的德国设备。

sentences.en: So the German factory now is looking at declining orders.
sentences.zh: 因此，德国工厂现在面对的是不断下降的订单。

sentences.en: And that, in turn, means that other countries in the European Union, in the Eurozone, who export to Germany,
sentences.zh: 反过来，这也意味着欧盟和欧元区内向德国出口的其他国家，

sentences.en: with Germany buying supplies from other countries that end up in its exports, they now see declining demand for their goods.
sentences.zh: 随着德国向其他国家购买最终用于其出口的物资，它们现在也看到了对其商品需求的下降。

sentences.en: So all of this ripples out.
sentences.zh: 所以所有这些都在产生连锁反应。

sentences.en: And anybody who's involved in trade is now looking at a much less robust set of opportunities than before the two largest countries on Earth started hitting each other with tariffs.
sentences.zh: 任何参与贸易的人现在所看到的机遇，都远不如地球上这两个最大国家开始互相加征关税之前那样强劲。

sentences.en: So, Peter, does that mean that the U.S.-China trade war is worse for a country like Germany than it is for China or the U.S.?
sentences.zh: 那么，彼得，这是否意味着美中贸易战对德国这样的国家来说，比对中国或美国更糟糕？

sentences.en: Yeah, it does.
sentences.zh: 是的，确实如此。

sentences.en: I mean, that's an important point for people to understand.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，这是人们需要理解的一个重要点。

sentences.en: So the advantage of being a giant economy, and both the United States and China are giant economies,
sentences.zh: 成为一个巨型经济体的好处——美国和中国都是巨型经济体——

sentences.en: is that whatever's happening in the rest of the world, you have this enormous domestic market that is giving you a certain amount of growth.
sentences.zh: 在于无论世界其他地方发生什么，你都拥有这个庞大的国内市场，能为你提供一定程度的经济增长。

sentences.en: I mean, whatever's going on in the world, people in your country are going to need houses, they're going to need clothing, they're going to need food to eat.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，无论世界上发生什么，你国家的人民都需要房子，需要衣服，需要食物。

sentences.en: That's going to require a certain number of truck drivers and warehouse space and catering supplies and dry cleaners and insurance agents.
sentences.zh: 这就需要一定数量的卡车司机、仓库空间、餐饮供应、干洗店和保险经纪人。

sentences.en: I mean, these are all parts of economies that function domestically, even if you're not exporting.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，这些都是在国内外运作的经济组成部分，即使你不出口也是如此。

sentences.en: The smaller your country and the more exposed you are to world trade, the less you have that advantage.
sentences.zh: 你的国家越小，对世界贸易的暴露程度越高，你就越不具备这种优势。

sentences.en: Now, Germany is a significantly sized economy, but it's very dependent on export.
sentences.zh: 现在，德国是一个相当规模的经济体，但它非常依赖出口。

sentences.en: And so when trade begins to diminish, when it even slows globally, Germany's got a problem.
sentences.zh: 因此，当贸易开始减少，甚至在全球范围内放缓时，德国就遇到了麻烦。

sentences.en: So what is the state of the trade war heading into this summit?
sentences.zh: 那么，在迎接这次峰会之际，贸易战的现状如何？

sentences.en: Well, the state of the trade war is that most Chinese goods are facing some kind of tariff with the threat that they will increase significantly.
sentences.zh: 嗯，贸易战的现状是，大多数中国商品都面临某种关税，并且面临大幅增加的威胁。

sentences.en: Then on Thursday, China retaliates and says that it's going to increase the tariff from 5% to 10% on $75 billion worth of U.S.
sentences.zh: 然后就在周四，中国进行报复，宣布将对价值750亿美元的美国

sentences.en: goods.
sentences.zh: 商品的关税从5%提高到10%。

sentences.en: And at that point, all hell breaks loose.
sentences.zh: 就在那时，彻底乱套了。

sentences.en: The president unloading a series of furious tweets.
sentences.zh: 总统在推特上连续发表了一系列愤怒的言论。

sentences.en: Our country has lost stupidly trillions of dollars with China over many years.
sentences.zh: 多年来，我们的国家在与中国的贸易中愚蠢地损失了数万亿美元。

sentences.en: They have stolen our intellectual property at a rate of hundreds of billions of dollars a year.
sentences.zh: 他们以每年数千亿美元的速度窃取我们的知识产权。

sentences.en: Starting on October 1st, the $250 billion of goods and products from China, currently being taxed at 25%, will be taxed at 30%.
sentences.zh: 从10月1日开始，目前被征收25%关税的2500亿美元中国商品和产品，将被征收30%的关税。

sentences.en: Most strikingly, he issues a directive.
sentences.zh: 最引人注目的是，他发布了一项指令。

sentences.en: Our great American companies are hereby ordered to immediately start looking for an alternative to China.
sentences.zh: 特此命令我们伟大的美国公司立即开始寻找中国的替代方案。

sentences.en: All American companies have to stop doing business with China.
sentences.zh: 所有美国公司都必须停止与中国做生意。

sentences.en: They have to stop using China as a place to make their goods and come back to the United States and make their goods there.
sentences.zh: 他们必须停止将中国作为制造商品的地点，回到美国并在那里制造商品。

sentences.en: And this is especially striking because, you know, let's remember that since the late 70s,
sentences.zh: 这尤其引人注目，因为，你知道，让我们记住，自70年代末以来，

sentences.en: China's been on this trajectory that was supposedly about opening itself up to market forces,
sentences.zh: 中国一直沿着这样一条轨迹前进，这条轨迹据说是关于向市场力量开放自己，

sentences.en: transitioning from its dogmatic form of communism to something that looks more like a market system.
sentences.zh: 从教条式的共产主义形式向更类似于市场系统的方向过渡。

sentences.en: And a key landmark was, in 2001, China gets the right to enter the World Trade Organization, which gives China access to export markets of the world at very low tariffs.
sentences.zh: 一个关键的里程碑是，在2001年，中国获得了加入世界贸易组织的权利，这使得中国能够以非常低的关税进入世界出口市场。

sentences.en: And in exchange, China's supposed to open up its market to international competition.
sentences.zh: 作为交换，中国理应向国际竞争开放其市场。

sentences.en: China's supposed to allow, essentially, market forces to play a much greater role in its economic life.
sentences.zh: 中国本应实质性地允许市场力量在其经济生活中发挥更大的作用。

sentences.en: And ever since then, American presidents have gone to China and they have criticized China for failing to live up to the terms of that deal,
sentences.zh: 自那以后，美国总统一直前往中国，并批评中国未能兑现该协议的条款，

sentences.en: for continuing to run a state-dominated economy in which major Chinese companies serve the interests of the Chinese Communist Party leadership,
sentences.zh: 批评中国继续维持由国家主导的经济，其中主要的中国公司服务于中国共产党领导层的利益，

sentences.en: where they get subsidies and other perks.
sentences.zh: 他们在其中获得补贴和其他津贴。

sentences.en: And so here is the president of the United States essentially treating American business not unlike a Chinese state-owned company.
sentences.zh: 因此，这里的美国总统基本上是将美国企业对待得如同中国国有企业一般。

sentences.en: Hey, Microsoft and Amazon and Apple and whoever else, you work for me, I'm the boss, and I'm telling you it's time to get out of China.
sentences.zh: 嘿，微软、亚马逊、苹果以及其他任何人，你们为我工作，我是老板，我告诉你们是时候离开中国了。

sentences.en: So all of that is the backdrop for the summit, which starts on Saturday.
sentences.zh: 所有这些都是周六开始的峰会的背景。

sentences.en: What actually happens?
sentences.zh: 实际发生了什么？

sentences.en: So Saturday, Trump lands in France, and in between meetings, he's telling anyone who will listen that,
sentences.zh: 所以在周六，特朗普抵达法国，在会议间隙，他向任何愿意听的人宣称，

sentences.en: no, he really does have the ability to force American companies to leave China.
sentences.zh: 不，他确实有能力迫使美国公司离开中国。

sentences.en: There's this obscure law that nobody's ever heard of.
sentences.zh: 有一个谁也没听说过的晦涩法律。

sentences.en: Well, in 1977, we had an act passed, a National Emergency Act.
sentences.zh: 嗯，在1977年，我们通过了一项法案，即《国际紧急经济权力法》。

sentences.en: I have the absolute right to do that.
sentences.zh: 我拥有这样做的绝对权利。

sentences.en: We'll see how that goes, but I have the absolute right.
sentences.zh: 我们将拭目以待，但我拥有绝对的权利。

sentences.en: 1977, check it out.
sentences.zh: 1977年，去查查看。

sentences.en: Then that night, he's the last world leader to arrive at an informal dinner with the rest of the leaders, and he's asked about the economy.
sentences.zh: 然后那天晚上，他是最后一个到达与其他领导人举行非正式晚宴的世界领导人，当被问及经济情况时，

sentences.en: He says, I think we're doing very well.
sentences.zh: 他说，我认为我们做得很好。

sentences.en: We're having a little spat with China, and we'll win it.
sentences.zh: 我们与中国有点小摩擦，我们会赢的。

sentences.en: And then on Sunday, we get this revealing, sort of confusing window into how Trump is thinking about this when he's asked at a press conference whether he has any regrets.
sentences.zh: 然后在周日，当他在记者会上被问及是否后悔时，我们得到了一个能够揭示、甚至有些令人困惑的窗口，来了解特朗普对此的想法。

sentences.en: Do you have any second thoughts on escalating the trade war with China?
sentences.zh: 你对升级与中国的贸易战有什么三思而后行吗？

sentences.en: Yeah, for sure, why not?
sentences.zh: 是的，当然，为什么不呢？

sentences.en: Might as well, might as well.
sentences.zh: 不妨这样，不妨这样。

sentences.en: Do you have second thoughts about escalating the war with China?
sentences.zh: 你对升级与中国的战争有什么反悔吗？

sentences.en: Just hours before the stock markets opened in the U.S.
sentences.zh: 就在美国股市开盘前几小时

sentences.en: For a president who rarely, if ever, expresses regret, today in France,
sentences.zh: 对于一个很少甚至从不表示后悔的总统来说，今天在法国，

sentences.en: President Trump made what seemed to be a surprising admission.
sentences.zh: 特朗普总统做出了一个似乎令人惊讶的承认。

sentences.en: And there's tremendous analysis.
sentences.zh: 并且有大量的分析。

sentences.en: Trump is actually backing down.
sentences.zh: 特朗普实际上在退缩。

sentences.en: Trump has second thoughts.
sentences.zh: 特朗普有了别的想法。

sentences.en: The American president hinted he regrets escalating his trade war with China.
sentences.zh: 这位美国总统暗示他后悔升级与中国的贸易战。

sentences.en: He told reporters he has doubts about ratcheting up his terror fight with China.
sentences.zh: 他告诉记者，他对加剧与中国的关税之争存有疑虑。

sentences.en: Well, there's so much of this speculation that it prompts the White House to issue a clarification.
sentences.zh: 嗯，有太多的这种猜测，促使白宫发布了一份澄清声明。

sentences.en: White House Press Secretary Stephanie Grisham put an entirely different spin on the president's words, issuing this statement.
sentences.zh: 白宫新闻秘书斯蒂芬妮·格里沙姆对总统的话做出了完全不同的解读，发表了以下声明。

sentences.en: His answer has been greatly misinterpreted.
sentences.zh: 他的回答被严重误解了。

sentences.en: President Trump responded in the affirmative because he regrets not raising the tariffs higher.
sentences.zh: 特朗普总统之所以作肯定回答，是因为他后悔没有把关税提得更高。

sentences.en: Did you find that speculation to be a little overheated?
sentences.zh: 你觉得那种猜测有点过头了吗？

sentences.en: I thought one way of interpreting that was just the president saying, yeah, sure, I second-guess myself.
sentences.zh: 我以为其中一种解读只是总统在说，没错，当然，我质疑过自己。

sentences.en: Who doesn't?
sentences.zh: 谁不会呢？

sentences.en: Which is perhaps a sign of just how important this trade war is.
sentences.zh: 这也许表明了这场贸易战是多么重要。

sentences.en: That even the slightest hint of self-doubt or vulnerability can swing billions of dollars.
sentences.zh: 以至于哪怕是一丝一毫的自我怀疑或脆弱感，都会引发数十亿美元的波动。

sentences.en: Oh, that's right.
sentences.zh: 哦，那是对的。

sentences.en: That's absolutely right.
sentences.zh: 那绝对是对的。

sentences.en: And yet we're dealing with a president who is very confident about sitting in front of a bunch of reporters and just sort of musing on the dynamic.
sentences.zh: 然而我们面对的是这样一位总统，他非常自信地坐在记者堆前，只是在沉思这种动态。

sentences.en: And also very big things are happening with China.
sentences.zh: 而且与中国相关的大事也在发生。

sentences.en: You probably read the breaking news a little while ago that they want to make a deal.
sentences.zh: 你可能不久前读过突发新闻，他们想达成一项协议。

sentences.en: So then on Monday, President Trump is back to calling Xi Jinping a great leader.
sentences.zh: 所以在周一，特朗普总统又开始称习近平为伟大的领袖。

sentences.en: One of the reasons that he's a great leader, President Xi, and one of the reasons that China is a great country is they understand how life works.
sentences.zh: 习主席之所以是一位伟大的领袖，中国之所以是一个伟大的国家，原因之一就是他们理解生活是如何运作的。

sentences.en: He says the Chinese have reached out and have sought to re-engage on trade talks.
sentences.zh: 他说中国人已经伸出援手，并寻求重新开始贸易谈判。

sentences.en: And he feeds the narrative that there's some optimism here.
sentences.zh: 他助长了这里存在一些乐观情绪的说法。

sentences.en: Maybe we'll get a deal.
sentences.zh: 也许我们会达成协议。

sentences.en: I have great respect for it.
sentences.zh: 我对此抱有极大的敬意。

sentences.en: I have great respect for it.
sentences.zh: 我对此抱有极大的敬意。

sentences.en: This is a very positive development for the world.
sentences.zh: 这对世界来说是一个非常积极的发展。

sentences.en: And predictably, the market's open and they're buoyant, as if this talk of decoupling and more trade war, for at least a day we can forget about that and just buy stock.
sentences.zh: 可以预见的是，市场开盘后一片欢欣鼓舞，仿佛这种关于脱钩和更多贸易战的谈话，至少有一天我们可以忘掉它，只管买股票就行了。

sentences.en: We'll be right back.
sentences.zh: 我们马上回来。

sentences.en: The New York Times app?
sentences.zh: 《纽约时报》应用程序？

sentences.en: Unlocked?
sentences.zh: 已解锁？

sentences.en: Everyone knows you need to subscribe to the Times to access all of the reporting.
sentences.zh: 众所周知，你需要订阅《纽约时报》才能访问所有的报道。

sentences.en: But what if you could explore the Times for a month, for free, without putting in a credit card?
sentences.zh: 但是，如果你可以免费探索《时报》一个月，而无需输入信用卡，那会怎么样呢？

sentences.en: Now you can.
sentences.zh: 现在你可以了。

sentences.en: When you download the New York Times app for the first time, your first month in the app is free.
sentences.zh: 当你首次下载《纽约时报》应用时，你的第一个月应用使用期是免费的。

sentences.en: A month to go behind the paywall to see what Times subscribers get every single day.
sentences.zh: 这是一个月的免费体验期，带你突破付费墙，看看时报订阅者每天都能获取什么内容。

sentences.en: If you don't already subscribe to the New York Times, download the Times app today and get free access for 30 days.
sentences.zh: 如果你还不是《纽约时报》的订阅者，今天就下载时报应用，即可享受30天的免费访问权限。

sentences.en: So given what you've told us about the implications of the trade war for the other members of the G7, what's the response to all this up and down at the G7 from those leaders?
sentences.zh: 那么，鉴于你之前向我们介绍的贸易战对G7其他成员国的影响，G7的这些领导人对上上下下的这一切有什么反应呢？

sentences.en: Well, you know, ever since Trump came into office, world leaders have spent a lot of time puzzling over what the real policies are from this White House.
sentences.zh: 嗯，你知道的，自从特朗普上台以来，世界各国领导人花了很多时间来琢磨白宫真正的政策究竟是什么。

sentences.en: They've parsed through these often contradictory statements, contradictory actions.
sentences.zh: 他们一直在仔细剖析这些往往相互矛盾的声明和相互矛盾的行动。

sentences.en: Amongst world leaders, the sense has been that on trade,
sentences.zh: 在世界各国领导人看来，在贸易问题上，

sentences.en: Trump is serious about trying to contain China.
sentences.zh: 特朗普是真心实意地想要遏制中国。

sentences.en: Trump is serious about his view that the U.S.
sentences.zh: 特朗普坚信美国在全球经济中

sentences.en: has been somehow fleeced in the global economy, which runs contrary to what just about every mainstream economist thinks.
sentences.zh: 莫名其妙地被坑了，这种观点与几乎所有主流经济学家的看法都背道而驰。

sentences.en: But Trump really does seem to think that, you know, if the U.S.
sentences.zh: 但特朗普确实认为，你知道的，如果美国从一个国家买的东西比卖给它的多，

sentences.en: is buying more stuff from a country than it's selling, that's a sign that it's getting ripped off.
sentences.zh: 这就是被敲竹杠的迹象。

sentences.en: And that's certainly the case with China.
sentences.zh: 对中国而言，情况当然也是如此。

sentences.en: But, you know, all of that said, the G7 leaders were pretty quiet.
sentences.zh: 但是，话虽如此，G7领导人们当时相当安静。

sentences.en: There was very little criticism for Trump's positions.
sentences.zh: 对特朗普立场的批评少之又少。

sentences.en: I mean, there was this very tepid statement from the new British Prime Minister, Boris Johnson.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，新任英国首相鲍里斯·约翰逊发表了一份非常不痛不痒的声明。

sentences.en: I just want to say, I congratulate the president on everything that the American economy is achieving.
sentences.zh: 我只想说，我祝贺总统在美利坚经济取得的一切成就上所做出的努力。

sentences.en: It's fantastic to see that.
sentences.zh: 看到这一点真是太棒了。

sentences.en: But just to register the faint sheep-like note of our view on the trade war, we're in favour of trade peace on the whole.
sentences.zh: 但为了表明我们对贸易战的微弱、随大流的看法，总体而言，我们是赞成贸易和平的。

sentences.en: You know, let's not get carried away.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，咱们别太忘形了。

sentences.en: Let's be careful that we don't do any damage to the world economy.
sentences.zh: 我们要小心，不要对世界经济造成任何损害。

sentences.en: Beyond that, the other G7 leaders were primarily in listening mode.
sentences.zh: 除此之外，其他G7领导人主要处于聆听状态。

sentences.en: And Peter, why do you think that that is?
sentences.zh: 皮特，你认为这是为什么呢？

sentences.en: Why are they so reluctant to criticise this?
sentences.zh: 为什么他们这么不愿对此进行批评？

sentences.en: China is a complicated question for the rest of the world, and especially for Europe, where there's a sense that they may not like the means that Trump is employing
sentences.zh: 对世界其他地方，尤其是对欧洲而言，中国是一个复杂的问题，那里有一种看法：他们可能不喜欢特朗普所采用的手段，

sentences.en: to try to readjust this relationship.
sentences.zh: 即试图重新调整这种关系。

sentences.en: But they do share this sense that China presents a serious, I mean, a really profound challenge to the modern global economy.
sentences.zh: 但他们确实有着共同的感受，即中国对现代全球经济构成了严峻的，我的意思是，真正深远的挑战。

sentences.en: So there is a shared sense, even if there's tremendous dispute over the chosen means, that it is time for a confrontation with China.
sentences.zh: 因此，大家有一种共识——尽管对所选手段有着巨大的争议——那就是现在是与中国对抗的时候了。

sentences.en: So there's a version of this where these other G7 countries, they're being hurt by this trade war.
sentences.zh: 所以，这里有一种情况是，这些其他的G7国家正受到这场贸易战的伤害。

sentences.en: But on some level, they welcome the U.S.
sentences.zh: 但在某种程度上，他们欢迎美国

sentences.en: confronting China over its trade policies, maybe because the U.S.
sentences.zh: 就贸易政策与中国对抗，也许是因为凭其体量，美国是唯一一个真正能做到这一点的国家。

sentences.en: is the only country, given its scale, that can actually do that.
sentences.zh: 好吧，我不会说得那么绝对。

sentences.en: Yeah, I wouldn't go that far.
sentences.zh: 他们其实更希望采取集体行动。

sentences.en: They would much prefer a collective effort.
sentences.zh: 事实上，他们非常担心特朗普贸易政策的主要危害之一，就是他极大地破坏了基于规则的贸易体系这一概念。

sentences.en: And in fact, they're very worried that one of the primary dangers of Trump's trade policy is he's dramatically undermined the concept of a rules-based trading system.
sentences.zh: 他完全绕过了本应作为贸易争端裁判的世界贸易组织。

sentences.en: He's completely bypassed the World Trade Organization, which is supposed to be the referee for trade disputes.
sentences.zh: 但普遍的看法是，至少在与中国挑起争端这件事上，

sentences.en: But there is a general sense that at least in picking a fight with China,
sentences.zh: 特朗普挑起了一场人人都有份的争端。

sentences.en: Trump has taken on a fight that is everyone's fight.
sentences.zh: 即使事实上，他很可能已经损害了世界组织起可能更有效的对华应对措施的能力，也就是集体行动。

sentences.en: Even if, in fact, he may well have damaged the ability of the world to marshal what might be a more effective response to China, which would be a collective effort.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，他破坏了国际合作的概念。

sentences.en: I mean, he's undermined the concept of international cooperation.
sentences.zh: 所以皮特，你的意思是，在G7会议上，这群所谓的经济盟友，他们其实可能很想讨论一下他们如何能作为一个集体采取行动。

sentences.en: So Peter, you're saying that at the G7, this collection of so-called economic allies, they might like to actually talk about how they could act as a collective.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，德国和法国将美国视为经济盟友的时代早已过去，这已经不在考虑范围之内了。

sentences.en: I mean, we're so past Germany and France viewing the United States as an economic ally, that that's not really in the cards.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，他们更多地是希望能安然度过接下来这一年带来的任何风波，而不会对欧洲经济、对他们各自的国家经济产生重大影响，

sentences.en: I mean, they're more hoping they can get through whatever the next year brings without significant impact to the European economy, to their own national economies,
sentences.zh: 并希望他们能够经受住特朗普最终发现他对中国的关税正在起作用的考验。

sentences.en: and hoping that they can withstand Trump concluding that his tariffs on China are working.
sentences.zh: 为什么我们不尝试一下，比如说，用这种方式来处理美国对德国的贸易逆差呢？

sentences.en: Why don't we try that in terms of, you know, dealing with American trade deficits with Germany, for instance?
sentences.zh: 德国非常担心，到了秋天，

sentences.en: Germany's very worried that come the fall,
sentences.zh: 特朗普会对进口到美国的汽车加征关税。

sentences.en: Trump is going to stick tariffs on imports of automobiles into the United States.
sentences.zh: 那对德国将是毁灭性的打击。

sentences.en: That would be devastating to Germany.
sentences.zh: 因此，德国很不愿随波逐流去搞任何涉及这样表态的事情：

sentences.en: So Germany is reluctant to go along with, you know, anything that involves getting to say,
sentences.zh: “我要用高额关税来保护国内产业，”就像特朗普对钢铁所做的那样。

sentences.en: I'm going to defend my domestic industry with steep tariffs, the way Trump has done on steel.
sentences.zh: 他们一点也不喜欢这个先例。

sentences.en: They don't like that as a precedent at all.
sentences.zh: 所以他们严阵以待。

sentences.en: So they're hunkered down.
sentences.zh: 在对华贸易战中，他们并不支持唐纳德·特朗普，但他们也不支持中国。

sentences.en: They're not rooting for Donald Trump in the trade war against China, but they're not rooting for China either.
sentences.zh: 他们希望能够挺过这一关，然后最终走到一个能够理想地与美国总统合作的境地，也许是未来的某位美国总统，

sentences.en: They're hoping that they can weather this and then eventually get to a place where they can ideally cooperate with an American president, maybe some other American president,
sentences.zh: 来应对他们确实认为对中国而言重大且不可避免的交锋。

sentences.en: to take on what they do view as a significant and inevitable fight with China.
sentences.zh: 那么皮特，特朗普总统希望得到什么呢？

sentences.en: And Peter, what is President Trump hoping for?
sentences.zh: 啊，这可能是一个无法回答的问题。

sentences.en: Ah, this is the potentially unanswerable question.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，特朗普似乎陷入了相互冲突的冲动之中。

sentences.en: I mean, Trump seems caught between conflicting impulses.
sentences.zh: 他似乎什么都想要一点。

sentences.en: He seems to want a bit of everything.
sentences.zh: 他想继续对中国的贸易战。

sentences.en: He wants to continue the trade war with China.
sentences.zh: 他想遏制中国，把中国当作竞争对手对待，甚至可能将美国的商业利益与中国剥离开来。

sentences.en: He wants to contain China and treat China like a rival and potentially even separate American commercial interests from China.
sentences.zh: 但与此同时，他想要赢得连任。

sentences.en: But at the same time, he wants to get reelected.
sentences.zh: 他想要强劲的经济。

sentences.en: He wants a strong economy.
sentences.zh: 而且很难找到一个折中点，既能真正升级贸易战，又不会在短期内损害美国经济。

sentences.en: And it's difficult to see where there's a middle ground where he can truly escalate the trade war without damaging the American economy in the immediate term.
sentences.zh: 这两样东西他无法兼得。

sentences.en: He can't have both of those things.
sentences.zh: 总得有所妥协。

sentences.en: Something's got to give.
sentences.zh: 如果他真的付诸行动，寻求将美国和中国经济脱钩，那么与中国的持续贸易战

sentences.en: The continued trade war with China, if he actually follows through on seeking to decouple the United States and the Chinese economies,
sentences.zh: 将对全球供应链造成极大的破坏，不仅对美国公司，对所有跨国公司都是如此。

sentences.en: that will be so disruptive to global supply chains, not just to American companies, to all multinational companies.
sentences.zh: 它会波及所有暴露在全球贸易之中的国家。

sentences.en: It will ripple out to any country that is exposed to global trade.
sentences.zh: 其结果将是许多地方经济命运的衰退，包括美国在内。

sentences.en: And the result of that will be declining economic fortunes in many places, including the United States.
sentences.zh: 美国和中国盘根错节，无法分割。

sentences.en: The United States and China are too intertwined to divorce.
sentences.zh: 在 globalization（全球化）时代，绝对没有办法在不让大量人口在短期内变穷的情况下将地球上最大的两个经济体分离开来。

sentences.en: There's simply no way that you can separate the two largest economies on Earth in an era of globalization without significant numbers of people winding up poorer
sentences.zh: 在短期内。

sentences.en: in the immediate term.
sentences.zh: 听着，我非常喜欢一个关于英国脱欧的比喻，那就是把英国从欧盟分离出去，就像试图去还原一个煎蛋一样。

sentences.en: Look, there's an analogy that I really like about Brexit, which is separating Britain from the European Union is like trying to, like, unmake an omelet.
sentences.zh: 我不知道就全球供应链而言，美中两国合适的比喻是什么，但它比一个煎蛋要宏大得多。

sentences.en: I don't know what the proper analogy would be for the U.S.
sentences.zh: 如果特朗普在未来几个月继续升级贸易战，我们就会加剧全球经济衰退甚至美国经济衰退的风险。

sentences.en: and China in terms of the global supply chain, but it's a lot bigger than an omelet.
sentences.zh: 皮特，非常感谢你。

sentences.en: If Trump continues to escalate the trade war over the next several months, we're increasing the risks of a global economic downturn and potentially an American recession.
sentences.zh: 谢谢。

sentences.en: Peter, thank you very much.
sentences.zh: 我们马上回来。

sentences.en: Thank you.

sentences.zh: 我想他会想要会面的。

sentences.zh: 我想伊朗希望理顺目前的局势。

sentences.en: I think he's going to want to meet.
sentences.zh: 那么，这是基于事实还是基于直觉？

sentences.en: I think Iran wants to get this situation straightened out.
sentences.zh: 这是基于直觉。

sentences.en: Now, is that based on fact or based on gut?
sentences.zh: 周一，在G7峰会闭幕新闻发布会上，

sentences.en: That's based on gut.
sentences.zh: 特朗普总统表示他愿意与伊朗总统哈桑·鲁哈尼会面。

sentences.en: On Monday, during the closing press conference of the G7 summit,
sentences.zh: 而鲁哈尼表示他对这样的会面持开放态度。

sentences.en: President Trump said he was willing to meet with the Iranian president, Hassan Rouhani.
sentences.zh: 在伊朗核协议破裂、严厉经济制裁

sentences.en: And Rouhani said that he was open to such a meeting.
sentences.zh: 以及围绕无人机和油轮的军事对抗之后，这些声明为两国领导人可能进行的面对面谈判奠定了基础。

sentences.en: The statements set the stage for a possible face-to-face negotiation between the two leaders after the breakdown of the Iranian nuclear deal, harsh economic sanctions,
sentences.zh: 法国总统埃马纽埃尔·马克龙几个月来一直在力促这种谈判，并在峰会期间多次向特朗普总统和伊朗代表提出这种可能性。

sentences.en: and a military showdown over drones and oil tankers.
sentences.zh: 在一项具有里程碑意义的裁决中，联邦法官下令强生公司向俄克拉荷马州支付5.72亿美元，以赔偿阿片类药物造成的破坏。

sentences.en: French President Emmanuel Macron has been urging such a negotiation for months and repeatedly raised the possibility to President Trump and representatives of Iran
sentences.zh: 强生公司在阿片类药物产业中扮演了重要角色，通过子公司供应了大量用于制造羟考酮等药物的原料，并亲自制造阿片类药物。

sentences.en: during the summit.
sentences.zh: 这起案件正受到阿片类药物制造商、分销商和零售商的密切关注，他们在全国面临着2000多起类似的诉讼。

sentences.en: And, in a landmark ruling, a federal judge has ordered Johnson & Johnson to pay the state of Oklahoma $572 million for the destruction caused by opioids.
sentences.zh: 这就是今天的《每日新闻》。

sentences.en: Johnson & Johnson played a major role in the opioid industry, supplying much of the ingredients used for drugs like oxycodone and manufacturing opioids itself through a subsidiary.
sentences.zh: 我是迈克尔·巴瓦罗。

sentences.en: The case is being closely watched by opioid makers, distributors, and retailers who face more than 2,000 similar lawsuits across the country.
sentences.zh: 明天见。
